name: 20772 · Uppr Marlboro, MD
findings: ZIP 20772 (Uppr Marlboro) has 283 nonprofit organizations. 109 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20772 (Uppr Marlboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
